QuestInfo.name: Training Never Ends
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# seems eager to talk to me about something...
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# is proud of you for reaching Lv. 90, but he doesn't want to see you stop your training. Learn from the Chief Knights and continue getting strong. If you do you might one day learn a new skill...
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# is proud of you for reaching Lv. 90, but he doesn't want to see you stop your training. Learn from the Chief Knights and continue getting strong. If you do you might one day learn a new skill...

0.0: #h0#. Are you getting lazy with training just because you've surpassed Lv. 90? Of course, you're strong, but your training doesn't end here. Look at the chief knights! They train endlessly to prepare themselves for the day they fight the Black Mage.

1.0: I suggest you visit other Chief Knights and ask for some words of advice. Who knows? You may be able to learn a #bnew skill#k in the process.
